scope: GNU real64 OpenMP 32; default 0.25 K bubble; dt=4; initialization, ten-step prefix, 60 s interval outputs; no three-hour rerun.

profile_adapter.scope: Instrumentation anchor resolution and current/previous source compilation only; no profiling/model run.

p3_minute_production_observed.definition: P3 surface liquid+solid flux converted from m/s to mm/s

p3_prefix_checked_observed.definition: P3 surface liquid+solid flux converted from m/s to mm/s

p3_prefix_production_observed.definition: P3 surface liquid+solid flux converted from m/s to mm/s

analysis.coordinate_decoding: Divide raw element index by product(shape_per_frame) for frame; unravel remainder in Fortran order. RK frame maps to step=frame//9+1, stage=frame%9+1. Indices in files are zero-based.

damping_contract.scope: Checked real64/OpenMP32; five first/subsequent calls against frozen damping, distinct shape/grid/dt contexts, two native objects vs fresh-process frozen trajectories; no P3 multi-object claim.

fixture.derivation: Prefix slice of profiles/coarse coordinates/response operators, unchanged geometry; all other values copied.
fixture.scope: Test-only lifecycle fixture; no physical validation of cropped response operators.

output_contract.scope: Checked real64/OpenMP32; fresh none/native/P3; three-minute initial/interior/final records, repeated/poisoned diagnostics, model/cache neutrality, reopen and error policies.

diagnose_contract.scope: Checked real64/OpenMP32; fresh none/native/P3; six checkpoints, three diagnoses each; full diagnostic precision/real32 fields, repeated refresh, state/cache/clock neutrality and five-step frozen identity.

integration_contract.scope: GNU checked real64/OpenMP32; fresh none/native/P3 processes; dt=6; five steps with no-op and explicit reset targets; fractional-dt interval replay.

messages: ERROR STOP Missing command argument value
ACE input: No such file or directory

initialization_contract.scope: Supplemental fresh-process initialization/error/600 s dry-native gates; frozen baseline workspace is read-only.

fixture_layout_audit.scope: Every decoded floating/integer variable bit preserved; storage chunks/compression layout changed only.

limits: Sequential native objects initialized once with fixed dt/grid are tested; no concurrent/reinitialized/mixed P3-native guarantee. P3 remains one object per fresh process.
Real32/serial evidence certifies compilation/linking only; numerical runtime acceptance is GNU real64/OpenMP32.
Explicit output close required; copying live model-owned output handles is outside this stage.
Cropped input and synthetic damping fixtures test lifecycle only, without scientific acceptance of altered grids/operators.
The existing Ref(nz,7) damping dummy/eight-column actual interface is retained.
Validation/saved-state callbacks still require GNU executable stack.
No long-experiment, performance, MATLAB or v0.24 scientific acceptance is claimed.
No automatic commit, next stage, push, tag or history merge.
